scope: Extend the existing Records read-only native acceptance driver with invalid-input and full-panel-reload dimensions. No browser, backend, product, build or release change in this lane.

source_contract.status_expectation: HTTP 200 with a finished tool_execution completion whose full_result.success is false

driver_contract: Trusted textarea input enters table_list with limit set to a nonnumeric string; the exact POST body, current bearer hash, organization header, completed Network request, full_result and matching visible JSON are checked.
The refusal must have success=false, error_type=invalid_arguments, and a message naming limit; a success response cannot pass.

Page.reload is issued; the panel must restore the same admin profile, visible organization and bearer identity before Tools is reopened and a second positive table_list read is run and visibly matched to its own completion.
Every execution observer is stopped after its corresponding request, including assertion failures.

local_verification.result: 9 tests passed; syntax and diff checks passed
negative_checks: wrong error type or message lacking limit

native_verdict: UNVERIFIED: no native launch in this implementation lane; fresh independent review required before the next admitted native run.
remaining: Root owns inventory, workflow, coordinator, independent review and any next native execution. C02 remains bounded; other Records actions and member mode are not covered here.
